newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stock trading halted due to computer problem.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stock trading halted due to computer problem.

text.p: Trading on the Korea Stock Exchange was suspended from 2.52 p.m. (0552 GMT) on Thursday due to a computer malfunction, an exchange spokesman said.
"Parts of our computer systems are not functioning, but we hope the problems will be fixed before long," said the official at the exchange's public information department.

He said the exchange has not yet decided whether trading would be extended to match trading time lost. Normal trading ends at 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT), followed by 30 minutes of after-hour trading from 3.10 p.m. (0610 GMT).
